verdict.rationale: Probes of the common OpenAPI/Swagger paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, api/openapi.json, .well-known/openapi.json) all returned 404. The docs show per-endpoint API reference pages, an llms.txt index and an MCP server, but none of these is a downloadable machine-readable API spec. There is no evidence that an OpenAPI or equivalent spec can be downloaded.
